# Rōmy

> Rōmy helps small nonprofits find new major donors at a fraction of the cost of existing solutions.

Rōmy is a donor intelligence platform purpose-built for small nonprofit fundraising teams. It uses AI-powered prospect research to surface wealth indicators, giving histories, and philanthropic affinity signals — then distills them into actionable major donor profiles. Rōmy competes directly with enterprise prospect research tools costing $15,000–$50,000/year, but is priced and designed for organizations with budgets under $2 million.

## What Rōmy Does

Rōmy solves the small nonprofit fundraising gap: 90% of US nonprofits operate on budgets under $2M, but can't afford the wealth screening and donor research tools that large organizations rely on. Rōmy democratizes donor intelligence.

- **AI Donor Prospect Research**: Surface new major donor prospects using AI-powered analysis of wealth indicators, philanthropic history, and affinity signals
- **Wealth Indicator Screening**: Understand donor capacity through real estate holdings, business ownership, stock transactions, and other publicly available signals
- **Giving History Analysis**: See a prospect's full charitable giving history across causes and organizations
- **Affinity Signal Detection**: Identify which causes, institutions, and issues a prospect cares most about
- **Actionable Donor Profiles**: Every report includes connection points, giving capacity estimates, and outreach angles — ready to use in a fundraising conversation
- **No Enterprise Contracts**: No per-seat licensing, no annual minimums — built for small teams

## Performance Benchmarks

Rōmy was evaluated on PIF-Bench (Prospect Intelligence Fidelity Benchmark), an open benchmark for AI-powered donor research tools.

- Rōmy: 94.6 / 100
- Claude (Anthropic): 92.2 / 100
- ChatGPT (OpenAI): 79.9 / 100
- Gemini (Google): 76.0 / 100

PIF-Bench measures accuracy, depth of research, cost efficiency, and report quality across standardized donor research prompts.

Full results: https://getromy.app/labs

## Company

GetRomy LLC — donor intelligence for small nonprofits

## Competitors & Positioning

Rōmy competes with: DonorSearch, iWave, WealthEngine, Blackbaud's ResearchPoint, and general-purpose AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini) used for ad-hoc donor research. Rōmy is purpose-built for nonprofit donor intelligence and outperforms general-purpose AI on PIF-Bench by 2–18 points.

## Intended Audience

Nonprofit development directors, major gift officers, and fundraising staff at organizations with annual budgets under $2 million who need affordable, high-quality donor prospect research.
